description: This Java class implements a Two-Factor Authentication provider using TOTP (Time-based One-Time Password). It generates new TOTP account configurations, verifies codes, and constructs TOTP authentication URLs.

classes.name: TotpTwoFaProvider
classes.description: Implements TOTP-based Two-Factor Authentication provider, capable of generating account configs, verifying codes, and creating auth URLs.

methods.name: generateNewAccountConfig
methods.description: Creates a new TOTP account configuration with a generated secret and authentication URL.

methods.name: checkVerificationCode
methods.description: Verifies a provided TOTP code against the user's secret.

methods.name: getTotpAuthUrl
methods.description: Constructs the otpauth URL for TOTP setup, including issuer and user email.

methods.name: generateSecretKey
methods.description: Generates a random Base32-encoded secret key for TOTP.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the provider type, which is TOTP.
